components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it is combined with the lastName to form the owner's
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence. On a successful create the returned value is the composed,
            normalized address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and
            the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized on create (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is normalized and appended to addressLine1 (separated by a
            single space) to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise the
            '+61' country code is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from
            the national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15
            digits, e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The birth date of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional.
            When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that region's postcode
            range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household); otherwise such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier assigned on create, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the region code derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to its city), the 2-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate
                (matching 'fiscalYear'), the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Collision handling keeps distinct owners' member
                ids distinct.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who live in the same household (same
                last name and address). Owners created into a shared household via the
                'sharesHousehold' flag receive the same value, derived deterministically
                from the household's last name and address.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's single derived identity into which all duplicate detection is
                consolidated, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email
                segment is empty when the owner has no email). A create is rejected with 409
                Conflict when it collides with an existing owner's identity.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jane@example.test|A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on
                create and never changed thereafter.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July, so a date on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending in the
                following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an
                email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2 for a household of 3 or
                more members, and gains 3 when tenure exceeds one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived on create from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived on read from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city
                is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for
                the owner's registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when an email
                is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans on read: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it is combined with the lastName to form the owner's
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence. On a successful create the returned value is the composed,
            normalized address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and
            the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized on create (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            When present it is normalized and appended to addressLine1 (separated by a
            single space) to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise the
            '+61' country code is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from
            the national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15
            digits, e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The birth date of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional.
            When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), must fall within that region's postcode
            range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address
            (i.e. they knowingly share a household); otherwise such a create is
            rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The integer version of the owner API contract. Always 2 for the version-2 owner
                identity release, in which the derived identifiers are grouped under 'identity'
                and rederived with a fixed 'V2' region tag.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on
                create and never changed thereafter.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July, so a date on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending in the
                following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0, gains 2 when an
                email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2 for a household of 3 or
                more members, and gains 3 when tenure exceeds one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived on create from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived on read from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city
                is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived on read from the owner's locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for
                the owner's registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49
                owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when an email
                is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans on read: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' remains in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when the new owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose lastName and postcode the new owner shares (with a
                different telephone), when 'possibleDuplicate' is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Derived on read: true when any of these hold, otherwise false. The owner is a
                possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a known disposable-email domain such as
                'mailinator.com', 'tempmail.com' or 'guerrillamail.com' - an exact disposable
                domain is already rejected on create, so only subdomains survive to be flagged
                here); or the owner's city is over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true,
                i.e. the city already held 40 or more owners when this owner was created).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read as the honorific 'title' followed by
                a single space and the 'lastName' (e.g. 'DR Who'). When the owner has no
                title the salutation is just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived on read as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}. A newly
                created owner is false; a soft-deleted owner is retained with this flag set true
                and is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity. The DTOs are generated from `openapi.yml`, so I changed the spec and the code that populates/derives the affected values.

**Identity derivation (V2 region tag inside identifiers)** — `OwnerRestControllerV1`:
- Added `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"` and `regionCodeV2(city, postcode)` = `"V2" + deriveRegion(...)`.
- `memberId` now uses the V2 region as its `<REGION>` prefix (e.g. `V2NSW27...`).
- `householdId` folds the V2 region into its SHA-256 preimage.
- `identityKey` (`identityKeyFor`, plus the mapper's `deriveIdentityKey`) appends the V2 region to its preimage. Duplicate detection and soft-match paths were updated to compute each owner's V2 region so identical owners still collide and same-household owners still share an id. Every identifier changes; no V1 value recurs.

**User-facing region stays plain** — `locality`, `timezone`, and the owner-segment region still use the untagged region (e.g. `NSW`), verified by Cp55 (`STANDARD_METRO`).

**Response shape** — `openapi.yml`: moved `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey` into a new nested `OwnerIdentity` schema referenced as `identity`, and added a top-level integer `apiVersion` (2). `OwnerMapper` builds the `identity` object and sets `apiVersion`.

**Audit schema v2** — `emitOwnerCreatedEvent` now emits `schemaVersion: 2`, carries the V2 `memberId`, and recomputes `ownerSegment` from the version-2 identity.

Request fields are unchanged. All existing and new (Cp52/53/55/56/57/60, etc.) tests pass.
